perspectives.statement: Selection includes examining whether its standard excludes the needed alternative.

perspectives.subject: Perspective selection
perspectives.statement: Selection concerns how a perspective shapes subsequent searches and commitments.

perspectives.subject: Perspective selection
perspectives.statement: Selecting a perspective need not make it permanently governing.

perspectives.subject: Perspective selection
perspectives.statement: Selection can recognize a required perspective that no initial menu contained.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization makes the perspective fit what the subject actually requires.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization removes unsupported claims and invalid transitions.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization changes the organization even when every stated proposition is true.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization makes consequential differences available where the account previously merged them.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization connects contributions whose separate availability did not produce understanding.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization creates or activates transformations unavailable under the earlier interpretation.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization removes structure that contributes no required distinction or operation.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization aligns claims of adequacy with the cases the perspective can handle.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization can replace the interpretation that made the current approach seem obviously right.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization includes revising what the inquiry originally assumed it should achieve.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization includes changing an inadequate rule for recognizing improvement.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization retains valid distinctions when other parts of the perspective change.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization changes how the subject can be encountered, not only described.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization can unlock understanding already possible but previously unavailable in practice.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization uses possible continuations to expose inadequacy before expressing the current account.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization uses other participants' access without reducing it to agreement or approval.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization arranges effort, memory, tools, and interaction around the missing interpretive capacity.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization must discover required structure when the initial specification does not contain it.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization can modify the process that generates and judges its own perspectives.

perspectives.subject: Perspective optimization
perspectives.statement: Optimization pursues complete adequacy while keeping its interpretation of adequacy available for replacement.
